Empower users to contribute to the growing body of knowledge of leading AI research.

Incorporate customer feedback into the model’s continuous training.

High-quality data is essential for ensuring unbiased and fair AI decisions, promoting ethical use, and preventing discrimination. B. Low-quality data reduces the risk of unintended bias as the data is not overfitted to demographic groups. C. High-quality data ensures the presence of demographic attributes required for personalized campaigns.
